description: Clean up recordings with an offline noise gate: threshold, attack and release smoothing, with before/after stats.

faqs.a: An envelope follower tracks the signal level; when it drops below your threshold the gate closes (with attack/release smoothing so it never clicks), silencing background hiss between words.
faqs.q: How does the noise gate work?

faqs.a: Set the threshold just above your noise floor — the stats show what percentage of the audio was gated.
faqs.q: How do I set the threshold?

faqs.a: Yes — the gate runs sample-by-sample on your audio data in your browser.

howto: Set the threshold (dB), attack and release times.
Click "Apply gate" and check the gated % stat.
title: Noise Gate (Lite)
